why: A campaign reference for keeping one visual idea coherent across hero art, social crops, motion cutdowns, and landing-page modules.

compositions.title: One dominant campaign idea
compositions.study: The main image, type lockup, and message all support one memorable campaign claim.
compositions.reuse: Use when a product or brand campaign needs recognizability across channels.

compositions.title: Responsive crop family
compositions.study: The key visual survives square, vertical, wide, and motion formats because the focal point is protected.
compositions.reuse: Plan crop-safe zones before designing the final hero.

assets.notes: Create original imagery or licensed assets only.
assets.reuse: Use a consistent subject, color contrast, and message lockup.

assets.notes: Motion should preserve the same visual idea rather than introduce a separate language.
assets.reuse: Use short loops, caption-safe framing, and clear first-frame hierarchy.

motion.title: Short motion variant
motion.notes: Animate the reveal, crop, or type sequence while keeping the product or campaign promise legible.
motion.fallback: The first frame must work as a static promotional image.

implementation.notes: Useful for landing heroes, launch pages, social packages, and ad creative systems.
